Working Relationship  
Marta and I collaborated daily during her tenure as a product manager at NexaCloud, where she bridged our academic research team with the company’s SaaS development. Her calm, methodical approach made her an ideal partner for translating complex technical concepts into actionable strategies. She consistently prioritized clarity, whether refining user personas or aligning with engineering constraints. Her curiosity about our work often led to productive brainstorming sessions, and her reliability ensured deadlines were met without friction.  

Day-to-Day Observations  
Marta’s strength lies in her ability to synthesize data into intuitive decisions. She frequently used Tableau to distill user feedback into visual insights, which guided feature prioritization. During our joint projects, she balanced stakeholder demands with technical feasibility, often mediating between sales teams and developers. Her Agile sprints were marked by meticulous backlog grooming, and she thrived in cross-team syncs, ensuring everyone understood shifting priorities.  

Standout Moments  
One memorable project involved reimagining NexaCloud’s onboarding flow. Marta led a week-long UX research sprint, synthesizing 100+ user interviews to identify pain points. Her roadmap for the feature, built on competitive analysis of three rivals, resulted in a 20% increase in user retention. Another highlight was her role in aligning the product team with C-suite goals during a quarterly pivot, where her stakeholder management skills kept the team focused despite ambiguity.  

Recommendation  
Marta’s blend of analytical rigor, collaborative spirit, and strategic vision makes her a standout professional. She approaches challenges with humility and a knack for turning data into value. I wholeheartedly recommend her for any role requiring both technical insight and people-centric leadership.
